text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. This will go a long<n>way toward
brightening up the<n>student council office.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Look how well-made it is... It perfectly<n>captures the
Umamusume's most<n>distinctive features.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is making me curious to examine<n>the others...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should come back again by<n>myself.
